zones.name: Recovery
zones.feel: Truly easy. If you have to think about the effort, it's too hard.

zones.name: Endurance
zones.feel: Bulk of your riding. Conversation pace, RPE 3-4. Long-ride target 150-190 W. After 2 h the ceiling drops about 10%, so go by feel.

zones.name: Tempo
zones.feel: Sustained, controlled breathing, RPE 5-6 (about 80-90% of 275 W).

zones.name: Threshold and above
zones.feel: From about 250 W up. Threshold and VO2max efforts, coached by cue rather than fixed watts.

workouts.title: Swim, 35 min (technique)
workouts.purpose: Critical swim speed (CSS) test. The two times give your threshold pace, which sets every later main set. Swim speed is driven by how little energy each metre costs, so we measure first and then train around it.

steps.target: Warm-up: 300 m easy, any stroke you like
Drills: 4 x 50 m, 15 s rest. Kick on your side, then catch-up crawl
Pace test. 200 m at your best even pace (not a sprint). Then 5 min easy rest (swim 100 m easy). Then 400 m at your best even pace. Write down BOTH times
Cool-down: 200 m easy

workouts.cue: Go out controlled: the 200 m should feel hard but even, the 400 m the same pace or a touch slower. Send me both times; CSS = 200 m divided by (400 m time minus 200 m time). Pool CSS overestimates what you can hold for 1.9 km, so treat it as a ceiling. Changes smaller than about 0.07-0.12 m/s are test noise.

workouts.title: Swim, 30 min (technique)
workouts.purpose: First main set built on your measured CSS. One swim a week keeps and slowly builds skill, so every session needs one clear job.

steps.target: Warm-up: 200 m easy
Drills: 4 x 50 m, 15 s rest. Kick on your side, catch-up crawl, count your strokes
Main: 4 x 100 m at your CSS pace from 30 Oct (if I have not sent it yet: steady, hard but even), 20 s rest. Then 2 x 25 m fast, 30 s rest
Cool-down: 100 m easy

workouts.cue: Hold the same pace on all four 100s. If you slow down by more than 3 s, stop after that one. Fast 25s are about clean form at speed, not about being exhausted.

fuel.before: Banana + bread with Nutella (or a bar) 60-90 min before the pool.
fuel.after: Dinner at home with protein and carbs within 2 hours.

slots.label: First choice
slots.text: Friday evening at the pool in Bornem. Only the order matters: snack first, dinner after.

slots.label: Fallback
slots.text: Skip it. No make-up.

workouts.title: Easy run, 30 min
workouts.purpose: Rebuild running durability slowly: tendons and calves adapt slower than your fitness does. Recovery week: back to the first-week length.

steps.target: Brisk walk to warm up
Easy run, RPE 3-4, you can talk in sentences. About 6:00-6:30 per km is fine. Walk breaks allowed
Walk and stretch calves and hips

workouts.cue: Easy means you could run it again tomorrow. Same effort as your run on 4 October or easier. Calf pinching? Walk it out and stop. If the same calf pain shows up in three runs in a row, see a physiotherapist before adding minutes. Change one thing at a time: minutes, pace, shoes or route, never two in one week.

fuel.after: Family lunch: a palm-sized portion of protein, a big portion of pasta, potatoes or rice, plus vegetables.

Dinner: 400 g potatoes, 150 g meat or fish, vegetables

notes: Plan from Thursday 8 Oct to Sunday 8 Nov. Your fixed training days are Tuesday, Thursday and Sunday, and Friday joins on 16 Oct (swim). Wednesday, Saturday and Monday are rest days. FTP test #1 is Tuesday 13 Oct (Thursday 15 Oct if you slept badly). Rate your left calf 0-10 after every ride: above 4, or a changed pedal stroke, means stop. On nights before 7-8 am sessions aim to be in bed by 23:30. Sunday travel back is by train. Calorie numbers are starting estimates for 75 kg and include what you eat on the bike. Send me the FTP test numbers so I can set your zones and interval watts. Class times (same every week): Mon 13:00-17:15, Tue 13:45-18:00, Wed 10:45-12:45 and 13:45-15:45, Thu 13:45-17:45, Fri 10:50-12:45. No class before 10:30, so mornings are free. Travel dorm-school is 30 min, showering and changing 1 hour. Workout times in this file are for ordering inside the app only, never for Wahoo. Evidence update 9 Oct 2026: strength uses one-leg work, slow reps and 1-3 reps left; swim gets a pace test on 30 Oct and a main set at your CSS on 6 Nov; the 29 Oct long ride logs kJ and tempo-block watts. The 3 weeks on + 1 week recovery pattern stays as the default, but the recovery week can be moved forward when sleep, mood or session quality drop. Aim for at least 7 h sleep (individual need varies). Fuel rides at 60 g carbs/h for up to 3 h; try more only in training and only if your stomach copes.
